last_scene.summary: Arlequino theatrically introduced himself to checkpoint chief Dagr and other beastfolk guards, declared he was going to the capital and wanted to meet Eurazania's ruler, then publicly performed a song titled 'Эуразанская ночь' on Rena's guitar, saying it had been dedicated to the Eurazania of his dreams and that future songs would be based on what he saw in reality. The performance proved to the skeptical guards that he was at least genuinely skilled as a musician. The unnamed female beastfolk spear-guard answered his flirtatious look with amused threat rather than offense. Dagr admitted the party into Eurazania but made clear that reaching ruler Carrion is not the same as being granted an audience; Arlequino must reach the capital and convince the appropriate authorities there. No payment was requested or received for the checkpoint performance. Gareth and Varn's original escort obligation to get Arlequino to Eurazania is now fulfilled at the border; continuing with them toward the capital would require a new agreement unless they independently choose otherwise. Rena continues with Arlequino by her own prior choice.
last_scene.continue_from: T+125 ~16:17 just inside the northern Eurazania border gate. Entry is approved. Rena remains with Arlequino. Gareth and Varn have completed the original escort-to-Eurazania contract and are free to leave unless a new agreement is made; do not decide that for Arlequino. Dagr has warned that an audience with ruler Carrion is not automatic. Arlequino's next meaningful choice is open: proceed, speak with guards, negotiate further escort, etc. Personal cash 20g60s49c.
